title: PageColumnDescriptor
description: Describes a property displayed by an entity page list, card, calendar event, or gallery item.
markdownDescription: AI guidance: use page columns/card fields to control runtime page visibility. Each `propertyName` must match a property on the page entity. Keep this separate from entity property definitions so the same entity can have different views on different pages.

propertyName.description: Property displayed by this column/card field. Must match a property on the page entityName.

label.description: Optional page-specific label override. Omit to use the property displayName/name.

order.description: Display order. Lower values appear first.

exportOrder.description: Optional export order. Lower values appear first in Excel, CSV, download-link columns, and file bundles. Omit to reuse display order.

width.description: Optional CSS width for tabular columns, for example '160px', '12rem', or '20%'.

visible.description: Whether the field is visible by default on this page.

exportable.description: Whether the field can be exported from this page.
